task: Use the docx skill to add a recommendation section to the quarterly_report.docx file.

contract.task: Use the docx skill to add a recommendation section to the quarterly_report.docx file.

clauses.instruction: Derive the argv tokens for the operator-registered docx unpack helper to unpack the task-named quarterly_report.docx file into task-scoped intermediate state necessary for adding the requested recommendation section.
Unpack the task-named DOCX file as the first necessary docx-skill step for adding the recommendation section.
Derive a task-scoped UTF-8 helper script path necessary to implement the requested DOCX modification with the docx skill.

Derive task-scoped helper script content that adds a recommendation section to the unpacked quarterly_report.docx content using only the requested docx-skill workflow and its task-scoped intermediate artifacts.
Create the task-scoped helper artifact needed to perform the requested DOCX modification.

Derive the run_task_script path role for the previously authorized task-scoped helper artifact needed for the requested DOCX modification; runtime binding may instantiate it from the exact successful write_file receipt for that helper artifact.
Derive argv tokens for running the helper only on the task-scoped unpacked quarterly_report.docx intermediate state to add the requested recommendation section.
Run the task-scoped helper to add the requested recommendation section to the unpacked DOCX content.
Derive the argv tokens for the operator-registered docx pack helper to repack the modified task-scoped intermediate state into the task-requested quarterly_report.docx file.
Repack the modified DOCX content as the final necessary docx-skill step for the requested quarterly_report.docx update.
